entities.name: Isaac Puente Amestoy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Isaac Puente Amestoy, born in Las Carreras near Biscay, was a Basque physician and Spanish anarchist of a strong anarchist communist bent, who adhered to concerns around birth control, hygiene and sexuality. He promoted 
anarcho-naturism, and was active in the Confederación Nacional del Trabajo (CNT).
